main_body: open wooden treasure chest overflowing with gold and gems, with a small coin pile on the right
top_band: open chest interior filled with heaped gold coins, gems, and angled lid at rows 1-7 above the light-brown front rim at row 8
evidence: Reading a vertical column through the middle of the chest: row 1 is the back lid rim, rows 2-7 (6 rows) show the open top surface filled with heaped gold coins and gems, row 8 is a continuous lighter-brown front edge line marking the front rim of the box, and rows 9-15 (7 rows) form the vertical south face with iron straps, recessed plank seams, and a lock plate.

style.evidence: Both the wood and gold ramps use 5 distinct lightness steps (cream-gold highlight down to deep brown-gold shadow; light wood edge down to deep warm brown shadow).
